name: Carl Hendricks
source:
Carl Hendricks was Chase's closest friend prior to high school, and shares ancestry with the founder of Echo, James Hendricks I. He also attended Pueblo University, and was roommates with Chase Hunter. He dropped out after one semester, and returned to live in Echo.

Carl maintains a relatively laidback and chilled demeanor. He frequently cracks jokes, and tends to spend most of his time hanging out at home, playing video games. He's typically non-judgmental, and often tends to poke fun at himself.
